sources.entry: Telegram Desktop - Telegram Desktop messaging app.

summary.one_liner: Telegram Desktop is the official desktop client for the Telegram messenger, with full source code and build instructions published by the project.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the complete source code and build instructions for the official Telegram desktop messenger client. The client is built on the Telegram API and the MTProto secure protocol. The README lists prebuilt targets: portable Windows builds (64 and 32 bit), macOS 10.13 and above, a 64-bit Linux static build, plus Snap and Flatpak packages. It also notes that version 4.9.9 was the last to support macOS 10.12 and older Linux systems with glibc. The source is released under GPLv3 with an OpenSSL exception.
use_cases: send and receive Telegram messages on a desktop computer
build the Telegram desktop client from source
install Telegram on Windows, macOS or Linux
study or modify an open-source messenger client
run Telegram through Snap or Flatpak on Linux
notable: Official Telegram desktop client with source published under GPLv3 with OpenSSL exception
Portable Windows builds in 64 and 32 bit
Version 4.9.9 kept as the last release for macOS 10.12 and older glibc Linux
caveats: Latest versions require macOS 10.13 or newer and Windows 7 or newer
Older systems are limited to version 4.9.9
